individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a set of pseudocoloured micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph panel, not a plot, so error bars do not apply.

individual-data-points.explanation: The main graphs plot individual time-point intensity measurements (scatter points) overlaid with the fitted model curve, not just averaged summary values.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The insets show data points with vertical error bars (average early time point responses), but the caption does not state what the error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM) or the number of replicates averaged.
